ns2:course.label: Topics for Honors Students
ns2:course.description: For candidates for honors in Spanish; intensive study of topics in Hispanic literature or linguistics. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor and of departmental honors advisor.
